Prepare crop inputs on source reporting polities

Source: R/prepare_polity_crop_inputs.R
prepare_polity_crop_inputs.Rd

Resolve original source observations before geographic aggregation, then prepare physical crop inputs for polity-native allocation. Source codes are provenance; all territorial matching uses the resolved polity code. This does not relabel the legacy prepared country-area pin, redistribute predecessor observations, or reconstruct historical crop composition.

Usage

prepare_polity_crop_inputs(
  data,
  method = c("mirca", "luh2"),
  output_dir = NULL,
  source_format = c("source_records", "faostat")
)

Arguments

data

Named list containing production, mapping, support, luh2, type_mapping, crop_patterns and input_revisions. Production requires source, character source_area_code, integer year, item_prod_code, harvested_area_ha and territorial_basis equal to "source_reported". This basis describes the source territory, not whether its numeric value was measured or estimated; retain source observation flags as additional columns. Already aggregated or backcast production must not be presented as original source observations. Optional numeric area_code and polity_area_code metadata are retained as input_area_code and input_polity_area_code in prepared outputs; they cannot become geography keys. The source-specific mapping requires source, source_area_code, start_year, end_year (exclusive) and polity_code. Its territorial correctness must be established by the source adapter; a unique match alone is not documentary evidence. Support is a complete partition from read_polycell_support(). LUH2 cells require year, lon, lat, luh2_type, crop_ha and irrig_ha, including supplied zeros for every required type in every cell. The type mapping requires item_prod_code and luh2_type. Crop patterns have the build_gridded_landuse() schema. input_revisions supplies nonempty revision identifiers for production, mapping, support, luh2, crop_patterns and, when used, mirca. MIRCA requires physical lon, lat, item_prod_code, irrig_ha and rainfed_ha, before any polity join. Patterns are applied to each year's reporting footprint; this is a spatial-pattern estimate, not an annual MIRCA observation.

method

Irrigation estimation method. "mirca" uses the ratio of weighted MIRCA irrigated to total hectares per polity and crop, then scales the crop targets to the polity's LUH2 irrigated area. "luh2" distributes each type's LUH2 irrigation among crops in proportion to their harvested areas. Both retain the legacy per-crop harvested-area cap; capping can leave physical irrigation unallocated. Missing inputs never trigger a switch of method. The chosen method is recorded.

output_dir

Optional directory in which to write native parquet inputs and their checksum manifest. Default NULL returns the inputs without writing them. Files use distinct native country-area/grid names.

source_format

Either "source_records" for the schema above, or "faostat" to extract harvested hectares from an unaggregated FAOSTAT production table. The latter requires Area Code, Year, Item Code, Element, Unit, Value and Flag; only Area harvested records in ha for the supplied crop-type mapping are selected. No geographic rows are silently excluded: restrict the raw input to the intended reporting scope explicitly, and unmapped territories fail. Supply the authoritative whep-polities FAOSTAT map with area_code, year_start, year_end (inclusive) and polity_code. The adapter converts inclusive endpoints to the native exclusive contract and retains FAOSTAT observation flags.

Value

A named list of prepared tables and a provenance manifest.

Examples

# A synthetic source observation with a supplied physical irrigation zero.
inputs <- list(
  production = tibble::tibble(
    source = "example", source_area_code = "region", year = 1900L,
    item_prod_code = 15L, harvested_area_ha = 30,
    territorial_basis = "source_reported"
  ),
  mapping = tibble::tibble(
    source = "example", source_area_code = "region",
    start_year = 1800L, end_year = 1950L, polity_code = "AAA-1800-1950"
  ),
  support = tibble::tibble(
    lon = 0.25, lat = 0.25, polity_code = "AAA-1800-1950",
    start_year = 1800L, end_year = 1950L,
    cell_area_ha = 100, land_area_ha = 100
  ),
  luh2 = tibble::tibble(
    year = 1900L, lon = 0.25, lat = 0.25,
    luh2_type = "c3ann", crop_ha = 100, irrig_ha = 0
  ),
  type_mapping = tibble::tibble(item_prod_code = 15L, luh2_type = "c3ann"),
  crop_patterns = tibble::tibble(
    lon = 0.25, lat = 0.25, item_prod_code = 15L, harvest_fraction = 1
  ),
  input_revisions = list(
    production = "synthetic", mapping = "synthetic", support = "synthetic",
    luh2 = "synthetic", crop_patterns = "synthetic"
  )
)
prepare_polity_crop_inputs(inputs, method = "luh2")
